verdict.rationale: First-party multi-agent docs describe running multiple isolated agents in one Gateway process, each with its own workspace, state directory, auth and session history. Multi-agent routing via channel accounts and bindings covers sending conversations and channels to specific agents. A community user independently reports running 9 agents from one machine, each with its own persona. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that each agent can have its own distinct model and system prompt (only implied by per-agent agentDir/config and the provider/model refs), plus detailed binding/routing examples in the evidence.
